name: Otouto Scramble
original_name: オトウトスクランブル
source:
The story is about our heroine Mirai (age 19) who is studying to be a preschool teacher and her mom suddenly remarries. The new stepdad has 4 sons and he and the mom suddenly say they’re going to France to work for like 6 months. They tell Mirai to take care of her new little brothers but soon Mirai will have to deal with her romantic feelings for them...

[edited from [url=https://breadmasterlee.com/2016/05/18/mobile-otome-game-review-otouto-scramble/]Hinano's post[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述19岁的女主角未来。她正在学习成为幼儿园教师，母亲却突然再婚。新继父有四个儿子，随后他和母亲突然宣布要去法国工作大约六个月。他们让未来照顾新的弟弟们，但很快，未来就必须面对自己对他们产生的恋爱感情……

[改编自[url=https://breadmasterlee.com/2016/05/18/mobile-otome-game-review-otouto-scramble/]Hinano的文章[/url]]
